buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses I. Delivery: The item should be delivered at Directorate of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Service s, Haddo, Sri Vijaya Puram, South Andaman. II. Experience: The bidder should submit relevant contract orders/CRAC along with the bid in support of h aving supplied some quantity during each financial year ie: 23-24, 24-25 & 25-26. III. Delay supply and Liquidity Damage: In case of delayed supply, liquidity Damage (LD) at the rate of 0.5 % per week or part thereof of delay with maximum of 10% of contract/order value will levied. In case o f further delay, the department can cancel the Purchase order at his own discretion or forfeit the Performa nce security. In case of delay in delivery the same rate of penalty may be levied. IV. Force Majeure in all cases where the delay or failure in performance of supply is directly or indirectly caused by or due to the act of God, war, mobilization, demobilization, requisition b y/or interference from t he government or local authorities force majeure lockout, labour disturbance, trade disputes, unavailability or shortage of materials, fires, riots, strikes and or civil commotion or any events or circumstances whatso ever beyond the control of supplier then in such cases the suppliers shall be entitled to an extension of tim e of contract for a period corresponding to the period of justified delay. Force Majeure shall not include an y events caused due to acts/omissions of such party or result from a breach/ contravention of any of the te rms & conditions of the contract. It shall also not include any default on the part of a party due to its neglig ence or failure to implement the stipulated/proposed precautions, as were required to be taken under the contract. In case of a Force Majeure, all parties will endeavour to agree on an alternate mode of performa nce in order to ensure the continuity of service and implementation of the obligations of a party under the contract and to minimize any adverse consequences of Force Majeure. Upon the occurrence of a Force Maj

eure event, the agency shall inform the other party in writing within ten days of the occurrence of such eve nt and the Department will make payments due for services rendered till the occurrence of Force Majeure. V. Termination Clause: a) The Director, AH&VS reserves the right to accept or reject the tenders/contract by assigning the reasons thereof in a transparent way. No claim, whatsoever, shall be allowed for the alleged loss/damage suffered to the bidders on account of such rejections. b). Both the parties of the Contract shall make all the effort to resolve the dispute amicably at the first inst ant. In case of failure, all disputes, controversies or claims of both the parties shall be referred to the Secre tary (AH&VS). The decision of the Secretary (AH&VS) shall be binding on both the parties. VI. Arbitration Clause: a) In case of any dispute between the parties arising out of the agreement, that shall be settled amicably b y parties. b) In case of failure, the same shall be referred for arbitration to a Sole Arbitrator appointed by the Chief S ecretary, Andaman & Nicobar Administration. The Arbitration proceeding shall be held at Sri Vijaya Puram in terms of the provisions of Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 and subsequent amendment made ther ein. The Arbitrator appointed under this clause shall pass the Award within a period of six months from the date of reference made to him and the decision of the Arbitrator shall be final and binding upon the parties . The Arbitration fee shall be borne by the parties equally. c) The competent Courts at Sri Vijaya Puram shall have exclusive Jurisdiction over the un-resolved dispute s arising out of this Agreement. VII. Documents to be uploaded: The prospective bidder shall fulfil all the requirements of the bid as sp ecified below and shall upload self-attested copies of the required certificates/documents in the GeM Portal . a. Copy of Registration Certificate of Establishment. b. Copy of valid License, if applicable. c. Copy of PAN Card of the firm/proprietor/partnership firm as applicable under the provisions of the Inco me Tax Act. d. Copy of valid Goods and Services Tax (GST) Registration Certificate. e. Copies of Income Tax Returns for the last three financial years i.e., 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2 026. f. The bidder must have an average annual turnover of minimum 50% of the estimated bid value during t he last three financial years (2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026). The bidder shall submit Audited B alance Sheet/Audited Income & Expenditure Statement/Audited Profit & Loss Account/Certificate issued by Chartered Accountant showing the turnover for the last three financial years. g. The condition of prior turnover and prior experience shall be relaxed for Start-ups as defined by the De partment for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT). 2. Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar pr oceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Bidders shall quote only those products (Part of Service delivery) in the bid which are not obsolete in th e market and has at least 7 years’ residual market life i.e. the offered product shall not be declared end-of life by the OEM before this period.

4. Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any respo nsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is l ower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 5. Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyer s can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 6. Commissioning, Testing, Configuration, Training (if any - whichever is applicable as per scope of supply) is to be carried out by OEM / OEM Certified resource or OEM authorized Reseller. 7. Manufacturer Authorization: Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the b id, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, a ddress, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid. 8. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a reg istered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 9. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components): Supply Testing Commissioning of Goods and Tr aining of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 10. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 11. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test c ertificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in th e bid document. 12. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Banker’s Cheque in favour of Asst. Accounts Officer, AH&VS payable at SRI VIJAYA PURAM. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the BC along with bid and has to ensur e delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 13. Execution of Agreement The successful bidder shall, upon receipt of the Letter of Award/Work Order and within the period specifi

ed by the Procuring Authority, execute a formal Agreement with the Procuring Authority on the terms and conditions contained in the bidding document and as accepted by the bidder. The Agreement shall be exe cuted on the prescribed format, wherever applicable, and shall be duly signed by the authorized represent ative of the successful bidder. Failure of the successful bidder to execute the Agreement within the stipulated period, without valid jus tification acceptable to the Procuring Authority, shall constitute a breach of the bid conditions and may res ult in cancellation of the award and/or forfeiture of the Earnest Money Deposit/Security Deposit, as applica ble, without prejudice to any other rights or remedies available to the Procuring Authority under the biddin g conditions or applicable law. 14. Warranty Successful bidder will have to ensure that adequate number of dedicated technical service personals/engin eers are designated/deployed for attending to the Service Request in a time bound manner and for ensurin g Timely Servicing/rectification of defects during warranty period, as per Service level agreement indicate d in the relevant clause of the bid. .
